test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In August 2020, two coastal villages of which of the following states were declared 'Tsunami Ready' by the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO for their overall preparedness to face the calamity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Two coastal villages in **Odisha **have been declared the first two **‘Tsunami Ready’ **villages in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• Odisha's **Noliasahi and Venkataraipur villages** have been declared "tsunami ready"
